description: Establish and confirm the green baseline before any change. This proves the starting state so every later regression is attributable. No source changes in this feature.
steps: Run: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" at the start of every bash call.
Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm it is clean.
Run `npm test` and confirm 578 passed / 4 skipped (no DB) OR 582 passed if DATABASE_URL is set.

Run `LLM_ADAPTER=scripted PAYMENT_ADAPTER=fake npm run demo:preflight` and record the vulnerable-vs-fixed headline counts. Confirm they are exactly vulnerable 8 passed / 10 safely-rejected / 2 escalated / 5 unsafe / 0 escapes -> fixed 11 / 13 / 1 / 0 / 0, and 12/12 policy rules exercised in both variants. Record the vulnerable 'Total money at risk (prevented)' figure (baseline ₹16,224.18) and note the reg-04-expired-quote and pert-01 per-row money figures shown in the detailed journey list.
Do NOT modify any source in this feature. Record the baseline numbers in findings.
acceptance_criteria: demo:preflight shows 8/10/2/5 -> 11/13/1/0 with 12/12 both, and the baseline money-at-risk figure is recorded in findings
findings: Baseline confirmed by orchestrator directly. typecheck clean. npm test: 578 passed / 4 skipped (no DB). demo:preflight (LLM_ADAPTER=scripted PAYMENT_ADAPTER=fake): vulnerable 8 passed / 10 safely-rejected / 2 escalated / 5 unsafe / 0 escapes -> fixed 11 / 13 / 1 / 0 / 0; 12/12 policy rules exercised in BOTH variants.
